haplotypecaller_memory_gb.title: HaplotypeCaller memory override (GB)
haplotypecaller_memory_gb.description: Leave empty for the default (72 GB, doubling automatically on each OOM retry). For deep/high-coverage samples, set a higher starting value to avoid the first attempt failing.

read_counts_scatter_mode.title: Read-counts scatter mode
read_counts_scatter_mode.description: How COLLECT_READ_COUNTS is sharded per sample. 'groups' splits into read_counts_scatter_count size-balanced shards via GATK SplitIntervals, bounding job count for cohort-scale runs. 'per_chromosome' shards one-per-chromosome for maximum parallelism on a single-sample run.

read_counts_scatter_count.title: Read-counts shard count
read_counts_scatter_count.description: Shards per sample when read_counts_scatter_mode is 'groups'. Ignored in 'per_chromosome' mode.

cnv_scatter_mode.title: CNV-chain scatter mode
cnv_scatter_mode.description: How ITER_ISEC/EAGLE_PHASING are sharded per tumor/normal pair. 'groups' round-robins chromosomes into cnv_scatter_count shards, bounding job count for cohort-scale runs. 'per_chromosome' shards one-per-chromosome for maximum parallelism on a single-pair run.

cnv_scatter_count.title: CNV-chain shard count
cnv_scatter_count.description: Shards per tumor/normal pair when cnv_scatter_mode is 'groups'. Ignored in 'per_chromosome' mode.
